test_runs.selector: Behavior handoff, event isolation, lifecycle, and relevant MCP integration bundle
negative_cases: Wrong consumer identity, owner/action, transport, event, result state, issued receipt, or isolation correlation fails closed.
SessionEnd never claims a durable behavior handoff and Stop never requests continuation.
Unbound chats remain output-inert and create no prompt index.
Bound prompt/Stop lifecycle integration remains secret-redacted and output-safe.
No release selector, fallback authority, installed slot, or activation state changed.
Source-only handoff changes remain uninstalled until Row210.

test_runs.selector: Python lint, compile, PowerShell syntax, JSON, and whitespace validation
test_runs.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check hook sources/tests; py_compile; PowerShell AST parse; JSON parse; git diff --check
test_runs.output: All checks passed; Python sources compiled; POWERSHELL_AST_PASS; JSON and diff checks returned zero
negative_cases: No live host hook, install receipt, hook SQLite, helper, tunnel, HIL, pointer, candidate, Git, or subagent action was invoked.
Only pytest-owned temporary directories were used by executable tests.

limitations: Row208 implements and verifies source-level handoff orchestration only; live installation and activation remain reserved for Row210.
The handoff proves exact consumer execution and binding, not semantic success of the skill result.
Row209 retains the final official-wire Stop source/package/installed fixture unification.
SessionEnd remains a deliberately empty, best-effort host boundary under the three-second cap.
